description.id: Tampilan manis bernuansa pink untuk toko kue, pastry dan dessert: hero dengan foto andalan, kategori berwarna, promo berhitung mundur, cerita toko, dan checkout satu halaman.
description.en: A sweet pink look for cake, pastry and dessert shops: a hero with a signature photo, colourful categories, a countdown sale, the shop's story, and a one-page checkout.
